messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off catalog enable for `mariner-lite-6b` canary (10% @ us-east-1). Rollout id=cr-67900. Change window 2026-04-02 01:30-03:30 UTC.

jamie-rel: Copy. I added the release note and flagged docs. Who owns fallback ordering for this family?

alex-infra: We should use an asymmetric ladder: primary=mariner-lite-6b -> fallback1=mariner-6b-quant -> fallback2=sequoia-compat -> fallback3=legacy-8b. We'll soft-pin customers tagged latency=low to prefer primary but keep fast fallback.

jordan-sre: Proposed rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 800ms for 3m OR 5xx spike > 0.8% for 5m. Also add an immediate circuit-breaker: if error budget consumption > 50% in 10m then force-degrade all canaries.

priya-ml: Quality check: ml-eval hook running SPM_SMOKE against baseline every 10m. If avg QA score drops > 3% for two consecutive runs, downgrade traffic to fallback1 and create a regression alert.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 10%. Telemetry path /ops/catalog/mariner-lite-6b. Use `deploybot status cr-67900` to inspect.

jamie-rel: Plan: hold at 10% for 90m, then 30% for 60m, then 60% if stable. Manual approvers: @jamie-rel, @alex-infra, @jordan-sre.

alex-infra: Note: eu-west cluster has constrained GPU slots this window. Adding region cap: eu-west max 4% for this canary to avoid contention. Also enabling route-preference so EU traffic will choose fallback1 if latency risk detected.

jordan-sre: I'll enable enhanced logging and 200 spans/min trace sampling during the first 45m. Pager thresholds set.

priya-ml: Eval hook will post summaries to this thread every +10m and create an incident PR if triggered.

ajamie-rel: (typo) meant @jamie-rel :)

alex-infra: Emergency rollback command tested in staging:
```
deploybot rollback cr-67900 --to=mariner-6b-quant --confirm
```
Please do a prod dry-run validation.

deploy-bot: Prod dry-run OK. Will publish warnings in-thread if any threshold crosses.

jordan-sre: LGTM. I'll keep a 2nd on-call standing by for escalation.

jamie-rel: Checkpoint at +30m and +90m. Posting the tracking doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/cr-67900. Leaving runbook pinned in the channel.

priya-ml: First eval at +10m. Early signals look good (low hallucination, quality within baseline). Will post numbers. Good luck everyone. :rocket:
